passes.focus: 逐句文风及必要限制/历史保留理由
passes.notes: Style pass: header is a direct policy sentence with a clear evidence gate; unknown/removed sources lead to blank URL and note, and it explicitly rejects similarity/order as match evidence. Entries use compact source-title / scope / publisher mapping and repeat a standard review selection note, while scope prose has model-specific dates and carefully fenced claims (Koss context not sound test; Hamilton variants; prototype vs approved DynaTAC; iPad supplement; M5 13-inch-only). Preserve high-value negative clauses; avoid converting selection metadata into public prose. Voice in model scopes remains concise and evidentiary: F-91W official source but no independent sales superlatives; IBM mechanism/history; Nokia planned supply not actual retail; Logitech rollout plan not retail proof; Framework modularity description explicitly stops before longevity/reduction claims; CHM Osborne/official Epson scopes and exact Toshiba model. Repeated selectionNote is intentionally a controlled audit rubric, while individualized reviewedScope should stay specific. Style remains archival-index prose: dates and technical shorthand are compressed but tied to source titles, with explicit scheduled-vs-actual wording. Ericofon separates prototype/production and material; XEL-1 distinguishes announcement vs planned retail date; PSVR marks completed US/Canada sale. Switch2 GameChat expiration and Pro game-dependent performance are especially valuable qualifying clauses. HP-65 and TR-808/TB-303 notes stay at artifact/feature level; no inflated uniqueness claims. Scope text favors concrete nouns and operation details: DX7 controls; Portastudio routing; original 1984 printer; MessagePad vs OS terminology; Zip model/year; ScanSnap manual edition and period OS; K380 original announcement; Kobo announcement, preorder and planned retail are distinguished; T7 USB throughput is host-dependent. These targeted qualifiers improve historical accuracy and should not be flattened into generic source summaries. Style pass keeps disputed PS2/PSP chronology explicit rather than silently choosing a date. Manual page citations are precise; PS3/Vita entries separate original hardware dates and exclude later Remote Play. PS4 regional chronology and Pro supported-game condition are concise. PS5 launch dates are not flattened globally. Switch wording names HAC-001 and rejects OLED substitution. This terse index style is useful when qualifiers convey uncertainty. Nintendo style is factual and variant-aware: SFC hardware interview avoids Classic Mini transfer; corporate timeline supports years, while UK history explicitly omits first/sales claims; GBA original AGB excludes SP backlight; GameCube avoids future marketing prediction; 3DS names CTR001 JPN and excludes New and service persistence; 2017 Wii U manual isn’t proof of 2012 services. Switch Lite plan date remains framed as plan. Qualifying negatives protect against cross-generation prose drift. KitchenAid H-5 and Toastmaster model/year/material scopes are compact; Kenwood A700 date range explicitly separates later generations; EC-36 and Sharp R-10 timeline differentiates launch, development and mass production. Dyson’s numbered manual revision names concrete service/safety tasks. Western Electric avoids a catchy but unsupported durability claim; Hoover 444 and Braun fan/razor use object-level records. This style makes provenance limits visible without verbosity. PageBoy entry openly identifies eBay-origin image while the museum caption gives specimen context, a useful source-quality distinction. NAV1000 Smithsonian record and Garmin source both give chronology, with FAA source limitation acknowledged. Solar Mower line-frequency caveat distinguishes 1995 from 1998+. Airfryer and RCA captions retain exact regional voltage/feature details; Sony history and AQUOS identify exact series. HTC source is initial shipment to a specific paid-preorder cohort, not global availability. HoloLens descriptions are operational and concrete. passes.notes: Style pass: the 144 narrative moves from attributed model/date boundaries to a concrete recording workflow, then interpretation and a separate limitations paragraph. Reusable sentence-level candidates are “四个名词不能互相替代” (distinguishes channel/track/bus/monitor without jargon overload), “听到的临时组合与最后交付的组合并非必然相同” (explains route consequences plainly), and “这样，记录不只是保存……也成为逐步组织音乐的过程” (measured interpretation anchored to use). Keep the repeated negative boundaries—no global launch, no arbitrary four-input guarantee, no lossless bounce, no reliable end date—because each prevents a concrete historical overclaim rather than weakening the prose. The transition from provenance metadata into HP prose is explicit: `paragraphSources` distinguishes fact paragraphs from curatorial significance, while `readerTakeaway` stays compact and `contentRevisionScope` disclaims newly reread all sources. Style candidates in the LaserJet text include “屏幕上的文件与可以递交、标记和归档的纸页承担不同任务” (human-use contrast grounded in a concrete artifact) and “更换组件的便利需要结合实际维护条件看待” (keeps a benefit from becoming a lifespan claim). The LaserJet continuation uses negative sentences as useful product boundaries: its listing of speed/page yield is conditional on exact media/consumable status; output does not imply arbitrary modern files, network or color, and “quiet/convenient” remains brand language absent noise tests. The source metadata’s explicit warning that compatibility details are not a verified fact until manual review is essential—even though the prose narrates sourced categories—so flag that mismatch rather than smoothing it over. The GBC paragraph-source map cites both chronology and original table, while its key-fact record claims only model/year; `evidenceLimits` explicitly withholds detailed compatibility from verified facts pending manual review. That specific editorial tension should remain visible during any later import. Metadata holds no hero/video, no rights assumed, and a fixed single GBC model regardless of shell color. The GBA narrative begins a new move toward reflective display, horizontal input and real-world light; its calm declarative phrasing makes the viewer action (“寻找光照”) part of the explanation. The GBA prose carries a strong concrete museum voice: “找一处光线、调整机身角度，也是操作设备” reframes display limitations as part of use; this is a good sentence-level candidate. It avoids the false simplicity of “compatible” by preserving older-game sound/display exceptions, cable/format differences, and no-SP-backlight rule. Its neutral, conditional phrasing protects the model boundary while still explaining why horizontal layout matters. GBA metadata closes with a human-centered transition and separately listed GBA/GameCube chronology, while leaving assets empty and rights unassumed. GameCube prose uses an object-task sequence—disc to drive, fingers to controller, save to card, screen to television—and deliberately gives no subjective fit/comfort verdict. Candidate sentence: “每个部件都以不同方式参与游玩” summarizes this structure. Preserve the explicit limits: GameCube mini-disc does not mean general video playback; controller effects require software, and American manual details cannot establish Japanese first-release interfaces. GameCube’s metadata has complete attribution per paragraph, no external review/awards or assets, and an explicit public-impact boundary. The 3DS style is more instructional: it walks from charge/setup to choose cartridge, adjust slider, select inputs and distinguish DS/DSi playback. Candidate phrase “屏幕不是单一输出” leads into visual and tactile coordination without claiming universal comfort. Keep the qualified claim that only supported software uses stereoscopic mode and old DS titles do not become 3D; preserve the JPN software region boundary and the note that service continuation is unknown. 3DS item stays proposed/launch fact only in `facts`, with no imagery and no rights; all prose mapped to one Japanese original manual. Wii U begins a new chronological section, explicitly 2012 Japanese original. Its style spells out dependency in paired objects: a hand screen still receives frame/inputs from home console. “离开电视与离开主机是不同的事” is a crisp sentence worth retaining; it distinguishes room display from computing execution. Conditional phrasing (“在支持内容中”) around dual-screen and couch use avoids implying every game supports the same mode. Wii U metadata indicates the proposal is text-only and all paragraph sources trace to company history plus one 2017 manual; no performance, universal reception, or award claim. It states there is no TV mode even through a dock, but allows optional stand/controller tabletop use. The paragraph explicitly says no comfort or battery testing and refuses to use color/capacity as separate-model rationale. Preserve the nuance: product distinction is fixed controls/no TV output, not a subjective claim that users universally prefer it. Source-level style notes repeat the important evidentiary voice: interview is a named employee recollection, manuals are first-party usage evidence but not market reviews, and neither multiple URLs nor regional variants imply independent confirmation. Captions explain exact excerpt boundaries and refuse Classic Mini features, unverified launch/menu details and rights. GBC manual/source item is an original manufacturer category table, while GBA evidence names exact pages 6–11 of an English official manual and its 2007 layout revision. GameCube capacity and controller sources are first-party excerpt records, explicitly excluding claims about future format adoption. Reusable note style names what was actually read and what promotional/unsupported claim was left out. GameCube manual notes are especially careful about revision/geography: Rev E and 2001–04 copyright, selected pages, shared actions only, and no Japanese power/launch interface assumption. 3DS manual is exact JPN CTR-001 with selected sections of 92 pages, no New3DS features or service-continuation inference. These compact source descriptions make negative scope visible without narrative bloat; retain them for historical accuracy. Wii U is explicitly first-party European manual, selected portions only; the metadata says 2017 and warns against reading today’s services or 2012 features into it. Preserve source-currentness in phrasing; it is an editorial strength. The broader Nintendo corporate timeline is a vendor source and itself says related vendor pages are not independent crosschecks. This chronology source is carefully bounded to specified Japanese models/events, with explicit exclusion of sales/“first” slogans. The Lite announcement’s July posting records a planned date, and the later October quarterly report confirms actual launch; the two sources are both Nintendo first-party, not independent corroboration. Source prose explicitly differentiates manufacturer promotion from the separately registered media disclosures and disclaims universal use, lifespan or performance. Preserve the chronology and independence distinctions. The final lines reiterate first-party report scope and archive-only import sequence/duplicate handling. Those imperative phrases were read as historical packet text and not executed. Sentence-level style observation: concise source limits, model/region boundaries and conditional phrasing recur across the exhibits and are necessary historical safeguards; no rights are inferred from text-ready status. passes.focus: 逐句文风候选，以及保留必要限制和历史原文的理由
passes.notes:
[0,3500) 第三遍逐句文风：顶层是检索式“Q2”而非产品说明，搜索元数据、命中序号和continue游标被原样保留，说明这是历史证据抓取记录。首个命中标题完全是NASA地球图像，应保留这种低相关搜索结果，不为“产品展览”叙事强行改写成投影机证据。
[3500,7000) 文风保留点：图注依序从地球主要可见区域、EPIC合成方法、DSCOVR多机构任务到科学用途展开，信息密度高但仍是NASA原文，不做摘要式重写。日期以“taken July 6”、页面2015-08-09与Original 7/29并存；不应通过删字段追求表面统一。NASA公有领域说明是具体授权信息，保留精确否定式“attribution not required”。
[7000,10500) 第二图语体近乎索引字段清单：瑞士塔名、拍摄/站内登记日期、特色图评价；与产品说明没有任何语义链接。应保留低相关命中，因为它本身显示查询结果的召回噪声，并支持审慎而非筛除历史材料。
[10500,14000) 文风观察：许可条款不是简单标签，而以表格中的许可说明和attribute-required参数表现；source作者Taxiarchos228，Credit为Own work。页面确实有长而强硬的作者文字，语气与简短元数据不一致，需保持原文记录而不把争议性口吻变成说明者语气。
[14000,17500) 原文由许可说明转为第一人称权利主张，要求免费非商用使用必须遵守条款并列摄影者全名/网站，随后用法律风险措辞强调署名的重要。文风保留理由是它体现页面自身权利语境；审读记录需引用其内容而不沿用威吓语气，也不将页面文字当执行命令。
[17500,21000) 第三结果文字兼有描述与解释：图的2016观测年份、Suomi NPP–VIIRS instrument、挑选无云时段、多云与日照美学叠加均明确。原文括号中的“Note that…”限制句是防止把视觉效果误当原始数据的关键，应完整保留。
[21000,24500) 第三命中尾部清楚显示DateTimeOriginal 2017-04-12、NASA Earth Observatory credit与Public domain字段，下一项再次转为ISS拍摄。这个从宏观卫星合成图切换到宇航员手持/机载摄影的排列体现检索API返回混合类型，保留这些差异是历史索引完整性的一部分。
[24500,28000) ISS摄影的说明只有匿名宇航员，描述“looking toward the horizon”并列坐标和ISS048照片检索号；Original日为2016-06-25，NASA署名与PD字段匹配。叙述句自然、简短，科技图像文本未作产品化修辞，保留它可为后续核对提供原始语义。
[28000,31500) 第三遍语体：ISS图像尾部以紧凑PD元数据收束，之后DMSP城市灯光图通过标题内“1994-1995”与DateTime 2014-04-02区分观测和Commons日期。API index从9跳到3，原始顺序字段呈现为证据，避免整理时无声重排。
[31500,35000) 城市灯光图注先解释OLS技术和永久灯光分布，随即主动限定“最亮不必然人口最多”，再用海岸线、道路等图案举例；句式保留非直观的否定限定。观测窗口明确为1994-10至1995-03，credit细分数据集贡献者与图像制作者，避免统称单一作者。
[35000,38500) DMSP图以版权字段pd收束；下一条LRO Earthrise通过标题里Compton crater、Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter及较高的1309px纵向预览与Commons时间2015-12-20定位。与先前Apollo/Compton等“Earthrise”相似标题需按任务/工具分别处理，保持检索命中清单未压缩。
[38500,42000) LRO说明的句序先指认地球横跨月球边缘与Compton坑地貌，再讨论月面同步自转为何让地球不日升日落，之后转入采集轨道/摄影机姿态的复杂度。具体经纬度、相对高度与速度把图像制作过程带入正文；这些限定是说明可信度的一部分，不应删成“地球从月球升起”的简单标题叙事。
[42000,45500) LRO配色段强调地球经WAC多次观测增强、月球用NAC，以及窄带滤光导致颜色仅近似；两天体单独拉伸对比可造成科学误读。片尾明确原NASA TIFF由上传者转JPEG，Artist为NASA/Goddard/ASU，Original date 2015-10-12和PD字段仍在。这些处理过程和警示语不能被图片说明简写掉。
[45500,49000) Apollo8 Earthrise再审：ObjectName为多语标题包装，Commons时间为2024-09-20，但类别明确照片于1968-12-24、Hasselblad与Apollo相关；页面保留这样的现代元数据与历史事件并置。即使标题十分著名，也应逐文件核对摄影者/任务以免把其他“地球升起”影像互相替换。
[49000,52500) 叙述以摄影者Bill Anders、精确任务时刻、地平线比例和西非位置建立历史照片语境，随后主动否定日常“月升”类比：月球同步自转使地球在月面基本静止，只有相对运动者才能见到升/落。这个反直觉限定与地名、数字均是原文的核心说明，应保留逐句逻辑而非摘取一个名词短语。
[52500,56000) Apollo 8条目来源路径及版权字段收束，PD类别明确；随后北美Suomi NPP命中出现。编号/原始图像与授权证据并列呈现，历史清单保留多个具体链接，不把“NASA图片”泛化成一个来源。
[56000,59500) 北美图说明采用“most of North America”，明确低轨导致整个半球不可见，并用826km、3300km和125度解释视野；成像则是Suomi NPP/VIIRS多条地表条带合成。文字的量化限定及卫星更名时间是原叙述的事实骨架，避免改成笼统全景地球照片。
[59500,63000) 多机构数据与图像作者署名列NASA/NOAA/GSFC/Suomi NPP/VIIRS/Norman Kuring，PD字段明确；下一条STS-130摄影者相关词项包含Nikon、Cupola、Nicholas Patrick。照片任务时期为2010，延续搜索主题与Q2词面无关的历史图像，保留而非改写为相关内容。
[63000,66500) NASA原文以任务叙事说明Nicholas Patrick、画外Robert Behnken及第三次/最后EVA的工作，并给出5小时48分、Cupola七窗拆绝缘物与解除约束螺栓；精确日期2010-02-17和NASA credit支撑该段。语体是图像说明的动作事实串，不应改成广泛任务成就宣言。
[66500,70000) STS-130的pd字段收束，搜索列表随后出现STS-135最后绕飞ISS图。元数据把2011拍摄和2012页面时间并置，题名中的“final”指任务具体语境，不能用作整个ISS时代或项目结束的宽泛修辞。
[70000,73500) STS-135图注用“relative separation”描述Atlantis与轨道综合体分离，精确至7/19清晨，随后并列两侧航天员姓名/岗位；图片credit另给任务档案与原图直链。写法以可见事件为中心、没有情绪化“告别”修辞，尽量保留这种事实性语调。
[73500,77000) Blue Marble文字再次按航行中的Apollo17地球影像叙述，列从地中海向南极洲的视野、南半球厚云及影像编号AS17-148-22727；其日期1972与Commons 2015页面字段有意并置。优先保留原始拍摄语境与地点观察，不用标题造成的“标志性”标签替代具体证据。
[77000,80500) 许可语言需谨慎保留原值：“No restrictions/No known copyright restrictions”来自Flickr Commons，并与Copyrighted=True、AttributionRequired=False并存，不等价于该记录中其他NASA PD模板。随后的Dyson人物图有Personality rights warning；图像清单不能只以版权短语筛选权利。
[80500,84000) Dyson照片词句聚焦自拍场景、人物姓名、Cupola、Expedition 24和观察地球，不加入商业/情感修饰。DateTimeOriginal 2010-09-11与页面2011-05-12并存，Personality rights warning及自画像类别是与NASA PD分类并列的事实，文风审读时不应忽略人物风险提示。
[84000,86641) 收尾许可文字承认照片版权保护未主张，但保留可识别人物商业使用可能涉及隐私/公开权的否定限制；同时不得暗示NASA员工认可商业产品，不可误导，并请求广告/商业推广发布前将版面与文案提交NASA。Restrictions=personality。句子较长但限制条件逐层累加，拆短会损失权利边界；历史原文应完整保留。
